entities.name: ATP synthase subunit a
observations: The 262-aa query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt ATP synthase subunit a entries from Haemophilus influenzae.
Subunit a forms a key part of the membrane proton channel and contributes to proton translocation.
Annotated to the bacterial cell inner membrane and proton-transporting ATP synthase complex; associated process is proton-motive-force-driven ATP synthesis.
